text: The Odd Fellows Hall in Old Town Eureka, California, also known as the French Empire Mansard Building, is a building constructed in 1883 that features Second Empire architecture.[2] Historically, it has functioned as a department store, a professional building, a clubhouse, and a meeting hall for Odd Fellows.[1][3] The property was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1978.[3] This article about a California property on the National Register of Historic Places is currently a stub and can be expanded with additional information.
